briefing.text: A quiet Monday. Maria confirmed the dinner for Mom’s 70th at Casa Lupo — twelve guests, 7 p.m. on 8 November — and asked you to pick up Aunt Rosa from the station. The client demo is on Friday; Ben is worried about database load.
highlights: Dentist follow-up tomorrow at 09:00 (crown on the lower left molar)
Client demo moved to Friday 23 Oct
Lease renewal due 31 Oct: rent goes from €1,450 to €1,520
Alice moves to Berlin on 12 January; you take over the vendor contracts

conversations.title: Dinner for Mom’s 70th
conversations.summary: Maria booked Casa Lupo for 7 p.m. on 8 November, twelve guests. Aunt Rosa comes by train; you’ll pick her up from the station that afternoon.
points: Pick up Aunt Rosa from the station

conversations.title: 1:1 with Alice: Berlin move and vendor contracts
conversations.summary: Alice’s move to the Berlin office is set for 12 January. You agreed to take over her vendor contracts. The Q4 budget cut is now 10 %, not 15 %.

conversations.title: Dinner with Jonas
conversations.summary: Jonas signed up for the Lisbon marathon in December and runs 30 km on Sundays. He recommended The Overstory. He is allergic to peanuts.

conversations.title: Stand-up: API migration done, demo moved
conversations.summary: Ben finished the API migration. The client demo moved to 23 October. Ben is worried about database load from the new queries; you’ll review his pull request.

conversations.title: Lease renewal with Tom
conversations.summary: Rent rises from €1,450 to €1,520 from January. Tom needs the signed renewal by 31 October and will fix the bathroom fan next week.

insight.headline: Friday’s client demo is the week’s big item: rehearse it this morning while the calendar is clear, and send Alice the Q4 budget, a day late. Lunch with Maria settles the seating plan.
